items.source:
These properties allow configuration of multiple named SSE connections to MCP servers.
Each connection is configured with a URL endpoint for SSE communication.
items.translation: 这些属性允许配置多个命名 SSE 连接到 MCP 服务器。每个连接都配置有用于 SSE 通信的 URL 端点。

items.source: Parameters for configuring an SSE connection to an MCP server.
items.translation: 配置到 MCP 服务器的 SSE 连接的参数。

items.source: map of connection names to their SSE parameters
items.translation: 连接名称到其 SSE 参数的映射图

items.source: Configuration properties for Server-Sent Events (SSE) based MCP client connections.
items.translation: 基于服务器发送事件（SSE）的 MCP 客户端连接的配置属性。

items.source:
# Simple configuration with default SSE endpoint (/sse)
spring.ai.mcp.client.sse:
  connections:
    server1:
      url: http://localhost:8080

# Custom SSE endpoints - split complex URLs correctly
spring.ai.mcp.client.sse:
  connections:
    mcp-hub:
      url: http://localhost:3000
      sse-endpoint: /mcp-hub/sse/cf9ec4527e3c4a2cbb149a85ea45ab01
    custom-server:
      url: http://api.example.com
      sse-endpoint: /v1/mcp/events?token=abc123&format=json

# How to split a full URL:
# Full URL: http://localhost:3000/mcp-hub/sse/token123
# Split as:  url: http://localhost:3000
#           sse-endpoint: /mcp-hub/sse/token123
items.translation:
# 使用默认 SSE 端点 (/sse) 的简单配置
spring.ai.mcp.client.sse:
  connections:
    server1:
      url: http://localhost:8080

# 自定义 SSE 端点 - 正确拆分复杂 URL
spring.ai.mcp.client.sse:
  connections:
    mcp-hub:
      url: http://localhost:3000
      sse-endpoint: /mcp-hub/sse/cf9ec4527e3c4a2cbb149a85ea45ab01
    custom-server:
      url: http://api.example.com
      sse-endpoint: /v1/mcp/events?token=abc123&format=json

# 如何拆分完整 URL：
# 完整 URL：http://localhost:3000/mcp-hub/sse/token123
# 拆分为：url: http://localhost:3000
#         sse-endpoint: /mcp-hub/sse/token123
